_comment: Curated. A name that means a different quantity in one particular function than everywhere else. Each entry re-maps (function, key) to a standard quantity id. Add an entry when the audit lists a name collision.

quantity.reason: Ic is the second moment of area of the section here (m4), not the CPT soil behaviour type index.
Mohr's circle is drawn in stress space (sigma, tau), so its centre is the mean stress s = (sigma_1 + sigma_3)/2 in kPa, not a position.
Mohr's circle is drawn in stress space (sigma, tau), so its radius is the maximum shear stress t = (sigma_1 - sigma_3)/2 in kPa, not a length.
Angle of the failure plane from the vertical, 45 - phi/2, in degrees.
